T8.3.title: Dry-run steps, backup video, names and roles

summaries.M0:
1. django-oscar runs on SQLite: 1,803 passed, 7 failed, 70 s, none of the failures in pricing code.
2. Only 7.6% of 367 offer/basket functions return a value in isolation; 38.7% run at all.
3. Every headless-testable hook behavior was confirmed on v2.1.318, so no fallback triggered.
4. A/B estimate is about $10 notional for 20 Sonnet runs; plugin eval works but the custom harness stays.
5. The prompt label needs a person, so it is MC-1 in MANUAL_CHECKS.md.
summaries.M1:
1. The plugin validates and loads; all five hooks and the MCP server are wired in exec form.
2. Hook runtime fails open, prints one JSON object, and clips context to 1,500 characters.
3. A real clean install takes one session start; the symlink re-exec bug was found and fixed by that test.
4. SessionStart warns about ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and gives Claude a summary.
5. Allow is expressed by omitting permissionDecision, so the guard never auto-approves (a logged deviation from FR-12).
summaries.M2:
1. billing-api has 12 API paths, 6 migrations, 2 event schemas, 45 passing tests and about 2,400 lines (the plan said around 3,000).
2. Five traps are documented in TRAPS.md; the repo's own tests stay green with the rounding trap applied, and a test proves that.
3. The generator builds 24 commits with planted co-change: 82% with rates.sql and 71% with close_month.py.
4. Ten A/B tasks exist, and each held-out check is proven to pass clean and fail on a bad edit.
5. billing-api is generated from tracked source (D-037), so run the build script after cloning.
summaries.M3:
1. The four lookup tables build on billing-api: 39 files, 15 routes from the framework, 163 contract items, 6 co-change pairs, 557 test-function pairs.
2. Harvest captured Decimal("40.20"), Decimal("0.025") from a test that never asserts on the fee.
3. Impact output reproduces the FR-09 example, under 1,500 characters, with a source on each item.
4. Live claude -p: MCP server connected, Claude called impact, and the skill ran after adding allowed-tools.
5. Coverage runs only on /legacyguard:index, not at each session start (logged).
